title: Indexing configuration positions
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $N,T$ be natural numbers, and let $i$ be a natural number. Write $s$ for the stride determined by $M,N,T$, and write $q=\lfloor i/s\rfloor$ and $u=i \bmod s$. The position assigned to $i$ is the work-cell position $(q,\lfloor u/(2T+1)\rfloor,u\bmod(2T+1))$ if $u<k(2T+1)$, where $k$ is the number of work tracks of $M$; otherwise it is the input position $(q,u-k(2T+1))$ if $u<k(2T+1)+N+2$, and the snapshot position at time $q$ in all other cases.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape alphabet
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the stride function, so its value cannot be given explicitly from this payload.
